waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: Windows Server DNS detections and workbook query the legacy Microsoft Sentinel DnsEvents standard table, which is populated exclusively by the Windows DNS AMA/MMA agent and does not have an Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API custom DCR contract (the lab ingestion registry supports CommonSecurityLog, Event, and Syslog only). Realistic mock records covering all 5 detections and workbook panels are committed in Sample Data/Tables/DnsEvents_mock.json, and all 5 detection pairs and 13 workbook queries executed live with HTTP 200 on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json, Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json).

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: Live alert firing requires ingested DnsEvents rows in the lab workspace, which is blocked because the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API does not support custom DCR ingestion into the legacy DnsEvents table (E2E-Q01). All 5 Analytic Rules and 5 XDR Custom Detections were deployed disabled via ARM and verified disabled in Defender XDR via Microsoft Graph readback and portal UI traversal (Evidence/receipts/graph-detection-deployment.json, Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json), and 5/5 query execution parity was verified live across Log Analytics and Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: 7-dimension fired-alert parity depends on live DnsEvents row ingestion (E2E-Q01) and live alert generation (E2E-Q02), which are blocked by the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API limitation on the legacy DnsEvents table. Query-level execution parity across all 5 Analytic Rule / Custom Detection pairs is verified 5/5 with HTTP 200 and matching (0, 0) row counts on Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json), and schema-valid mock records are committed in Sample Data/Tables/DnsEvents_mock.json.

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: Non-zero workbook query row counts in the lab workspace require live DnsEvents ingestion, which is blocked because the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API does not support custom DCR ingestion into the legacy DnsEvents table (E2E-Q01). All 13/13 Dns workbook KQL queries executed live with HTTP 200 on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (QUAL-RUNTIME-01 PASS; Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json), and the Defender workbook rendered in the portal with 0 query errors and working parameter pickers (Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json).

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: E2E-V04 is the rollup check requiring all qualification-evidence.json sections to be PASS. Deployment (ARM + Defender workbook readback), dualSurfaceKql (5/5 detections + 13/13 workbook queries HTTP 200 on LA and AH), imageRendering, uiTraversal (12/12 pages, 51/51 assertions), and urlVerification all PASS; mockIngestion, dataConnectorIngestion, alertLifecycle, alertParity, and non-zero workbookQualification row counts are waived under E2E-Q01/E2E-Q02/E2E-Q03/E2E-Q04/QUAL-DC-01/QUAL-MOCK-01/TK-Q08/TK-Q11 due to the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API platform limitation on the legacy DnsEvents table.

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: Live data connector ingestion for Windows Server DNS (DNS / WindowsDnsEvents via AMA) requires a domain-joined Windows DNS Server forwarding agent telemetry into DnsEvents / ASimDnsActivityLogs, and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API does not support custom DCR ingestion into the legacy DnsEvents table. Both data connectors were deployed via ARM and verified in the Defender Sentinel data connectors UI blade (Evidence/receipts/arm-deployment-readback.json).

Schema-valid mock data covering all 5 detections and workbook queries is committed in Sample Data/Tables/DnsEvents_mock.json (E2E-V02 and E2E-V03 PASS), and all 5 detection pairs executed live with HTTP 200 and matching row parity on both Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).
